items: 【Unique Plant Holder Design】 Multi-tier metal flower rack not only provides enough storage space for your flower pot, but also decorates your living room, bedroom and office with modern appearance, make your house have a pleasant view.

【5 Tier Tall Plant Shelf】The Indoor Plant Stand includes 5 shelves, 23.54(L) x 23.54(W) x 41.85(H) inches,perfect for flower pots of various sizes and shapes, each plant can soak up sufficient sunlight to thrive. In addition to showcasing your lovely plant, you can also use it for your pictures or memorable knickknacks.

【Keep Balance ＆ Stable】 The corner plant stand is mode of durable matal and MDF board, which has a smooth surface, with the function of compression resistance, waterproof, and stable structure. The bottom of the plant rack with 4 anti-slip foot stickers , holding your heavy-duty potted plant securely without scratching the floor.

【Easy to Assemble】We have prepared clear installation videos, instructions and installation tools to make your assembly easier.The modern plant stand is suitable for placing in the corner to enhance its stability. Also recommended to place a heavier plant pot below and a lighter pot on the upper layer.
【Professional after-sales service】Dear customers, if you have any quality problems, please contact us, our experienced customer service team will reply within 24 hours.
